transcript: Namaste, main D4-P1 se bol raha hoon. Paracetamol ke sirf 50 strip bache hain, bukhar ke mareez badh rahe hain since somvaar.
D4 P3 PHC se, ORS ke 30 packet bache hain. Dast aur bukhar ke case bahut badh gaye hain, kal tak khatam ho jayega.
D7-P2 report: insulin ke 12 vial bache hain, fridge theek chal raha hai, mareez same hain.
D2-P4 se bol rahi hoon. Amoxicillin ke 200 capsule hain, footfall kam hai is hafte.
D5-P1 PHC: antimalarial ke 25 dose bache hain, malaria ke case badh rahe hain, supply jaldi chahiye.
